evidence: The deposition of ZrO2 and HfO2 was performed at the same temperature (300 °C) using alternating surface-saturating reactions of metal chlorides (ZrCl4 and HfCl4, respectively) and H2O in a cold wall-type, high-vacuum ALD system. Each precursor was pulsed for 2 s, and N2 purging was followed for 30 and 60 s after H2O and metal precursor pulsing, respectively.
